task: Repair Scrapy offsite filtering when allowed domain configuration contains null entries

subtasks.description: Reproduce null configuration reaching regex validation
lessons: A green historical test file can still miss the intended case when its setup override is misnamed.

subtasks.description: Filter null domain entries before type-specific matching
lessons: Normalize heterogeneous configuration before applying regular-expression operations; separately decide whether other invalid strings must be excluded.

constraints: The benchmark Python 3.8.3 runtime was unavailable, so verification used Python 3.9.6 with isolated current dependencies.
The evaluator-only fixed commit was not inspected until the candidate hash was recorded.
No raw logs or source patch content are published.
lessons: Filter null configuration values before every type-specific validation step, not only before final serialization.
Test setup reachability must be verified when an expected regression unexpectedly passes.
A focused alternative can be valid for the reported crash while still covering less behavior than the human repair.
